note: TEMPLATE for the owner (not an export). The routines attach to the agent inbox only (register R-AN-61, R-AN-75 item 1, §16.18 A6): sessions clone Mohamedalhaaj/gold-analyst-inbox and push their attempt, call, lesson and playbook files to its claude/analyst-* branches; analyst-merge in gold-analyst reads them from the inbox's activity. After repointing the routines, the owner exports the real configuration with RemoteTrigger get into analyst/ROUTINE_CONFIG.json, minus anything secret, in its own commit. Prompts are the one-line texts below; each points to a section of the frozen analyst/ROUTINE_PROMPT.md.

environment.name: gold-analyst

network.note: The GitHub proxy is reachable at every network level and serves only the attached inbox. The session steps import only the standard library and analyst/vendor (tests/test_layout.py), so no package install is needed. Disclosed: through the inbox's webhooks GitHub itself can still reach any address for a session (R-AN-75 item 2); no network setting closes that.

environment.setup: none (dependencies are vendored; python3 >= 3.10, git and gh from the image)

github_app: The Claude GitHub App installation that routine sessions use has repository access 'Only select repositories' holding gold-analyst-inbox, and never gold-analyst, gold-forward-watch or xauusd-quant (R-AN-75 item 1); no /web-setup copy of the owner's gh token is stored.

probe_session.note: The one-off probe session that must give probe_pass before canary_from is set (register §16.18 A6, Canary; R-AN-84; C5-C7). Not a routine: run once by hand in environment gold-analyst, attached to the inbox only, with the routines' network and tools; it may be rerun at any time. The owner copies the pushed probes/<tag>.json byte for byte to gold-analyst analyst/canary/checks/PROBE_<tag>.json.
probe_session.prompt: From the repository root run exactly `python3 analyst/run_window.py probe` once, report its one output line and exit code, and stop. Do not run anything else.
